description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Floor Pan for the Driver’s (LH) and Passenger’s Side (RH).
Comes Pre-primed in Gray/Brown Primer
These are made by the OEM manufacturer, however are not considered OEM
These are a good, inexpensive way to put new floor pans with correct fitment into vehicle. They are not perfect, and may have hand press bends and pinches.
Best result is to cover these with a floor covering after final prep/paint.
Caution: Read Below Statements
Note: These Floor Pans are made for a RHD Samurai but can be modified to fit the LHD Samurai. Affects Seat Tower Bracket & Connection Locations Only. Floor Pan size and Cut Pattern are the same for LHD & RHD
Inspect Pictures and Ask Questions before purchasing because these parts can’t be returned.
Condition Statement: Floor Pans are new sheet metal body parts and as such may have minor dings from shipping via sea freight. All sheet metal body parts must be prepared prior to final painting. Items may also contain surface rust.
Special Notice: This part requires the use of welding to be properly installed.
Non-Returnable/ Sale is Final
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Floor Pan (Driver Side – LH)
Qty 1 – Floor Pan (Passenger Side – RH)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
